### 🗡️ Nightscar Yone

A darker and sharper take on Yone, featuring a high-contrast black & white aesthetic, enhanced visual effects, and a more powerful cinematic presence.

---

### ✨ Features
- **Custom base model** – a darker, heavily bandaged form of Yone
- **Recolored textures** – high-contrast black & white theme for a distinctive look
- **Enhanced spell particles** – cleaner, heavier and more impactful VFX
- **Amplified ultimate** – improved effects using various assets to deliver extra power 
- **Custom UI elements** – loading screen, HUD, and in-game icon
